definitions: A punctuation mark ( ' ) used to indicate possession or the omission of letters or numbers.
The addressing of an O, or of an absent person, or of a personified thing, as if present.
A mark ( ʾ ) used in some transliterations of Semitic languages to represent a glottal stop.
examples: The apostrophe in "it's" indicates a contraction.
Shakespeare often used apostrophe in his plays.
The apostrophe in the Arabic word signifies a specific sound.
